target: 2000 Lexus GS300 JZS160, US LHD, naturally aspirated 2JZ-GE VVT-i, stock automatic target
scope: Factory documentation and photographs support component identity and visible form. None supplies a complete measured 3D engine or engine-bay surface model.

sources.title: Toyota / Lexus Technical Information System
sources.status: Public content description reviewed; subscription repair library not accessed
sources.use: Primary acquisition route for configuration-specific repair manuals, electrical wiring diagrams, New Car Features and technical training. Select Lexus, 2000, GS300 and the 2JZ-GE sections; GS400 V8 sections do not apply.
sources.limit: No paid access purchased. Do not mark unviewed manual pages as inspected.

sources.title: Lexus Parts Center Online
sources.status: Portal reviewed; vehicle selector did not load in the retrieved page
sources.use: Confirm component identities, assemblies, production applicability and supersessions against a privately held VIN or confirmed production date.
sources.limit: Exploded parts drawings establish relationships, not surveyed dimensions. No exact OEM part numbers newly assigned.

sources.title: Lexus GS300 factory VVT-i cutaway photograph (1997–2000)
sources.use: Compact forward cover and VVT-i mechanism orientation. Confirms that a display cutaway removes portions of protective shells; it is not the appearance of an intact engine.
sources.limit: UK archive, engine-family reference only. Not evidence for US installation coordinates, hidden passages or tolerances. Source image is linked, not redistributed.

sources.title: Lexus RM718U excerpt: EC-4 PCV system and EM-55 cylinder head
sources.kind: Manufacturer manual on a third-party mirror
sources.status: PDF pages 10 and 11 rendered and visually inspected; printed EC-4 and EM-55
sources.use: PCV elbow/seat and hose connection; separate head covers and manifold; existing four appearance-cover nuts corroborated. Source header explicitly identifies 2000 GS300/GS400 and the relevant 2JZ-GE sections.
sources.limit: Excerpt is incomplete. Modeled valve port sizes, spring/flow behavior, hose routing and all installation measurements remain unverified. No repair instructions or page images copied into the site.

sources.title: Lexus second-generation GS300 launch technical specification
sources.use: Engine-family identity: inline six, DOHC 24 valves, 2997 cc, nominal 86 mm bore and 86 mm stroke.
sources.limit: UK launch specification, not a US 2000 parts-fit record. Bore/stroke do not determine casting shape, bore spacing or piston clearance.

sources.title: Photographed 2000 US GS300 engine bay
sources.use: Installed appearance: rear intake crossover, forward black cover, air duct, battery, strut towers and brake reservoir. Used to compare the engine inside the surrounding body.
sources.limit: Perspective image, no calibration or scale target; battery is aftermarket and stock condition is not certified. Dealer V6 description rejected.

excluded.reason: The inspected illustration explains VSC/ABS/TRC, not engine internals.
